children: Bansal brings over two decades of HR experience across consumer products, financial services, technology and international operations

Greenlam Industries has appointed Nishit Bansal as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), effective 22 September 2026. The appointment was approved by the company’s Board through a circular resolution following the recommendation of its Nomination, Remuneration & Compensation Committee.

Bansal will lead the company’s human resources function, bringing experience across HR business partnering, talent management, organisational development, leadership development, talent acquisition and HR technology.
Moves Into CHRO Role
Bansal joins Greenlam Industries after a brief stint at Tata Consumer Products, where he served as Vice President–HR for India sales, packaged beverages and Organic India from July 2026.

In that role, he worked with business leaders across general trade, modern trade, e-commerce and emerging channels. He also supported the packaged beverages business, aligning HR priorities with operational requirements.
His appointment at Greenlam Industries adds to a career spanning more than two decades across consumer products, financial services and technology, as well as international operations.
Experience Across Markets
Before Tata Consumer Products, Bansal spent nearly five years with Tata International, from September 2019 to April 2024, as Head HR – Sub-Saharan Africa.

He was responsible for HR for the distribution business across 12 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa and Vietnam, supporting a workforce of more than 1,200 employees. His responsibilities included manpower planning, talent acquisition and management, talent development, compensation and benefits, HR operations, policies and labour relations.

Earlier, Bansal worked with Max Life Insurance as Assistant Vice President from April to September 2019. He handled HR for operations covering customer service, quality, underwriting, claims, IT services, digital and business operations.
Earlier Samsung Tenure

Bansal spent nearly five years with Samsung between 2012 and 2019 in several HR roles. His assignments included HR operations and employee relations at Samsung R&D Institute Noida, global HR planning at Samsung Electronics in South Korea, and senior HR roles focused on talent and organisation management at Samsung R&D Institute India.
His Samsung experience also included work with the Global Job Evaluation Task Force in South Korea in 2017.

Earlier in his career, Bansal worked with Hughes Communications India as Manager – Corporate HR from November 2010 to June 2012 and with Genpact as a Human Capital Management Consultant from January to December 2010.

From June 2006 to January 2010, he was an HRIS Consultant with Mahindra Satyam, where his work included international assignments in Yemen and Australia and projects in the Philippines, Malaysia and Switzerland.
Academic Background
Bansal began his professional career after completing a summer internship with Torrent Pharmaceuticals in 2005.
He holds a BTech in Computer Science from Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University and an MBA in Human Resource Management from IMT Ghaziabad.

His appointment comes as Greenlam Industries places its human resources function under an executive with experience spanning business partnering, workforce management, talent development and HR operations across multiple sectors and geographies.
